column9: Very strong primary-lane fit for instructional design management, ID strategy, portfolio-scale design standards, product/content partnership, team guidance, assessment/curriculum architecture, learning analytics, and emerging learning technology adoption. Compensation $130K-$159K is within target range. Main cautions: location says United States rather than explicitly remote, and role may require stronger product/business-facing ID framework ownership and analytics/ROI depth than the CV directly proves. Recommend shortlist/apply.
